title: ECMAScript: Test if bind() function is supported.
product-requirement: Device needs to support Function.prototype.bind() to create a new function that, when called, has its this keyword set to the provided value.
specification: Terminals MUST implement at least ECMAScript 6.0 [1]
assertion: Testing if the bind() function is supported, passing the user object into the original function 'func' which return a phrase that should be match with the expected value to pass the test.
